input_audio.description: Absolute path to an existing audio file (wav/mp3/flac/ogg).

mode.description: variation = audio-to-audio remix/style or timbre transfer of the whole clip; inpaint = regenerate only [start,end] and keep the rest; continue = extend the clip to duration_seconds, regenerating from just before the end of its audible content (see overlap_seconds)

prompt.description: What the result (or the regenerated region) should sound like. May be empty for continue.

strength.description: variation only: init noise level. ~0.4 keeps melody/rhythm (timbre transfer), ~0.6 style transfer, 0.8+ loose.

duration_seconds.description: Output length. variation/inpaint default = input length; continue = required total length (> input length).

overlap_seconds.description: continue only: start regenerating this many seconds before the end of the audible content, so a trailing fade or silence is replaced and the join is smooth.

seed.description: Base seed for reproducibility; omit or -1 for random.

title.description: Short name; used as the file name and stored in metadata. Auto-named if omitted.

original_idea.description: The user's original request, verbatim and in their language. Stored in metadata only.

peak_ceiling_db.description: Safety ceiling in dBFS: a louder peak is turned down to this, quieter audio is untouched. null disables.
